# Argus

> Zero-SaaS pre-flight dependency interceptor and AI slopsquatting firewall powered by Cisco Project Quarry and real-time killswitch bus.

## Core Capabilities
- Pre-Flight AST Interception: Intercepts dependency installations before package managers access the network.
- Zero-SaaS Heuristics: Local evaluation of package release age, version velocity, and Levenshtein typosquat similarity.
- Cisco Project Quarry Runtime: Standardized offline package reputation and maintainer trust schemas.
- Real-Time Killswitch Bus: Broadcasts instant SIGKILL payloads over `~/.argus/argus.sock` upon malicious package detection.

## CLI Usage
- `argus audit --package <name>`: Evaluates safety and reputation of a target package name.
- `argus scan`: Inspects workspace lockfiles for hallucinated dependencies.
- `argus doctor`: Verifies interception shims and local reputation caches.

## Key Sockets & Paths
- Killswitch Socket: `~/.argus/argus.sock`
- Audit Log: `~/.argus/audit.log`
- Documentation: README.md & AGENTS.md
